responses.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus

assumptions.assumption: High bandwidth usage means bandusagepct strictly greater than 47.6 (the cutoff itself is excluded).
Telescopes with a NULL calibrstatus are grouped together as one group; telescopes with NULL bandusagepct are excluded by the filter.

alternatives.interpretation: High bandwidth usage includes the cutoff value, i.e. bandusagepct >= 47.6.
